subject: maths
prompt_en: A farmer packs 156 coconuts equally into 6 sacks. How many go in each sack?
prompt_hi: Ek kisaan 156 nariyal 6 boriyon mein barabar bharta hai. Har bori mein kitne?

subject: maths
prompt_en: 475 coconuts are packed in sacks of 25. How many sacks?
prompt_hi: 475 nariyal 25-25 ki boriyon mein bhare jaate hain. Kitni boriyan?

subject: maths
prompt_en: Divide 250 by 8. Give the quotient and the remainder.
prompt_hi: 250 ko 8 se bhaag do. Bhaagphal aur shesh batao.
answer: 31 remainder 2

subject: maths
prompt_en: Predict: when you divide any number by 5, what is the biggest remainder you could get?
prompt_hi: Andaaza lagao: kisi bhi number ko 5 se bhaag dene par sabse bada shesh kitna ho sakta hai?

subject: maths
prompt_en: 17 ÷ 5 = 3 remainder 2. Mona wrote 3.2. Do they mean the same thing?
prompt_hi: 17 ÷ 5 = 3 shesh 2. Mona ne 3.2 likha. Kya dono ka matlab ek hi hai?
answer: No: 3 remainder 2 means 3 in each group and 2 whole ones left; 3.2 is a different number

subject: maths
prompt_en: Why can the remainder never be equal to or bigger than the number you divide by?
prompt_hi: Shesh kabhi bhaajak ke barabar ya usse bada kyun nahi ho sakta?
answer: If it were, you could make one more full group, so you haven't finished dividing

subject: maths
prompt_en: Rahul wrote 824 ÷ 4 = 26. Check his work.
prompt_hi: Rahul ne likha 824 ÷ 4 = 26. Uska kaam check karo.
answer: Wrong: 824 ÷ 4 = 206; he skipped the 0 in the tens (2 tens ÷ 4 = 0)

subject: maths
prompt_en: 1,200 eggs are packed in trays of 30. How many trays?
prompt_hi: 1,200 ande 30-30 ki trays mein pack hote hain. Kitni trays?

subject: maths
prompt_en: A coconut farm picks 2,345 coconuts. They are packed in sacks of 25. How many full sacks, and how many coconuts are left over?
prompt_hi: Ek nariyal farm se 2,345 nariyal tode gaye. Unhein 25-25 ki boriyon mein bharte hain. Kitni poori boriyan, aur kitne nariyal bachenge?
answer: 93 full sacks and 20 left over

subject: maths
prompt_en: Show 156 ÷ 6 by breaking 156 into easy parts, like 120 + 36.
prompt_hi: 156 ÷ 6 ko aasaan hisson mein todkar dikhao, jaise 120 + 36.

subject: maths
prompt_en: Teach Chintu how to check that 250 ÷ 8 = 31 remainder 2 is right.
prompt_hi: Chintu ko sikhao ki 250 ÷ 8 = 31 shesh 2 sahi hai, kaise check karein.
answer: 31 × 8 = 248, add the remainder 2 to get 250; and 2 is less than 8

subject: maths
prompt_en: You have ₹50. One pen costs ₹15. How many pens can you buy?
prompt_hi: Tumhare paas ₹50 hain. Ek pen ₹15 ka. Kitne pen khareed sakte ho?

subject: maths
prompt_en: 29 laddoos are packed 6 to a box. How many laddoos are left over?
prompt_hi: 29 laddoo ek dabbe mein 6 ke hisaab se pack hote hain. Kitne laddoo bachenge?

subject: maths
prompt_en: 45 people go on a boat ride. Each boat carries 8. How many boats are needed?
prompt_hi: 45 log naav ki sawari par jaate hain. Har naav mein 8 log. Kitni naavein chahiye?

subject: maths
prompt_en: Predict before dividing: 100 cm of ribbon, and each bow needs 30 cm. Will you get 3 bows or 4?
prompt_hi: Bhaag dene se pehle andaaza lagao: 100 cm ribbon hai, har bow ke liye 30 cm chahiye. 3 bow banenge ya 4?
answer: 3 bows (10 cm is left, not enough for another)

subject: maths
prompt_en: Both stories are 23 ÷ 4 = 5 remainder 3. Story A: 23 kids in autos of 4. Story B: 23 rotis shared by 4 kids, whole rotis only. Why are the answers different?
prompt_hi: Dono kahaniyon mein 23 ÷ 4 = 5 shesh 3 hai. Kahani A: 23 bachche, 4-4 ke auto mein. Kahani B: 23 rotiyan 4 bachchon mein, sirf poori roti. Jawab alag kyun hain?
answer: A needs 6 autos so no child is left behind; B gives 5 rotis each, with 3 rotis left over

subject: maths
prompt_en: Why do we need 6 autos for 23 students, not 5?
prompt_hi: 23 bachchon ke liye 6 auto kyun chahiye, 5 kyun nahi?
answer: 5 autos carry only 20 students, so 3 would be left behind

subject: maths
prompt_en: The teacher planned 4 vans for 47 children, 10 per van. Check her plan.
prompt_hi: Teacher ne 47 bachchon ke liye 4 vans ka plan banaya, har van mein 10. Plan check karo.
answer: Not enough: 4 vans carry 40, so 7 children are left; she needs 5 vans

subject: maths
prompt_en: A rope is 200 cm long. How many 30 cm pieces can you cut from it?
prompt_hi: Ek rassi 200 cm lambi hai. Usse 30 cm ke kitne tukde kaat sakte ho?
answer: 6 (20 cm is left over)

subject: maths
prompt_en: Your class of 38 is ordering pizzas for a party. Each pizza feeds 4 kids. Pizzas cost ₹120 each. How much will the pizzas cost?
prompt_hi: Tumhari 38 bachchon ki class party ke liye pizza mangwa rahi hai. Ek pizza 4 bachchon ke liye. Ek pizza ₹120 ka. Kul kitne paise lagenge?

subject: maths
prompt_en: Draw 17 coconuts going into sacks of 5. How many full sacks, and how many coconuts are left on the floor?
prompt_hi: 17 nariyal 5-5 ki boriyon mein daalte hue banao. Kitni poori boriyan, aur kitne nariyal zameen par bache?
answer: 3 full sacks and 2 on the floor

subject: maths
prompt_en: Teach Chintu how to decide what to do with a remainder.
prompt_hi: Chintu ko sikhao ki shesh ke saath kya karna hai, yeh kaise tay karein.
answer: Read the story: if everyone must fit, add one more group; if only full groups count, drop it; if the question asks for the leftover, give the remainder

subject: maths
prompt_en: You have ₹100 and each notebook costs ₹30. How many notebooks can you buy?
prompt_hi: Tumhare paas ₹100 hain aur ek copy ₹30 ki. Kitni copies khareed sakte ho?

subject: maths
prompt_en: Turn the letter S upside down (a half turn). Does it look the same?
prompt_hi: Letter S ko ulta ghumao (aadha turn). Kya woh waisa hi dikhta hai?
answer: Yes

subject: maths
prompt_en: A ceiling fan has 3 equal blades. How many times does it look the same in one full turn?
prompt_hi: Ek ceiling fan mein 3 barabar blades hain. Ek poore chakkar mein woh kitni baar waisa hi dikhta hai?

subject: maths
prompt_en: The Ashoka Chakra has 24 equal spokes. How many times does it look the same in one full turn?
prompt_hi: Ashoka Chakra mein 24 barabar teeliyan hain. Ek poore chakkar mein woh kitni baar waisa hi dikhta hai?

subject: maths
prompt_en: Predict: if you turn a rectangle (not a square) a quarter turn, will it look the same?
prompt_hi: Andaaza lagao: ek rectangle (square nahi) ko quarter turn ghumaane par kya woh waisa hi dikhega?
answer: No; it looks the same only after a half turn

subject: maths
prompt_en: Compare the letters A and S. Which one has a mirror line, and which one has turn symmetry?
prompt_hi: Letters A aur S compare karo. Kismein mirror line hai, aur kismein turn symmetry?
answer: A has a mirror line but no turn symmetry; S has turn symmetry (half turn) but no mirror line

subject: maths
prompt_en: Why does a rangoli flower with 4 equal petals look the same after a quarter turn?
prompt_hi: 4 barabar pankhudiyon wala rangoli phool quarter turn ke baad waisa hi kyun dikhta hai?
answer: The 4 equal petals are spread evenly around the centre; a quarter turn moves each petal into the next petal's place

subject: maths
prompt_en: Mohit says the letter L has turn symmetry because it looks the same after a full turn. Check him.
prompt_hi: Mohit kehta hai letter L mein turn symmetry hai kyunki poora ghoomne par woh waisa hi dikhta hai. Check karo.
answer: He is wrong: every shape looks the same after a full turn; turn symmetry needs a match before a full turn, and L has none

subject: maths
prompt_en: A paper pinwheel has 6 equal arms. What is the smallest turn after which it looks the same?
prompt_hi: Ek kaagaz ki firki mein 6 barabar haath hain. Sabse chhota kitna turn ghumaane par woh waisi hi dikhegi?
answer: One-sixth of a full turn

subject: maths
prompt_en: Name something at home or outside that has turn symmetry but no mirror line.
prompt_hi: Ghar ya bahar ki koi aisi cheez batao jismein turn symmetry ho par mirror line na ho.
answer: For example a pinwheel, a fan with curved blades, or the letters S, Z, N

subject: maths
prompt_en: On a dot grid, describe a design that looks the same after a half turn but not after a quarter turn.
prompt_hi: Dot grid par aisa design batao jo aadhe turn ke baad waisa hi dikhe, par quarter turn ke baad nahi.
answer: Any design with only half-turn symmetry, e.g. join dots to make a rectangle 4 dots long and 2 dots tall, or draw a Z or N on the dots; it matches after a half turn but not after a quarter turn

subject: maths
prompt_en: Teach Chintu how to test whether a design has turn symmetry using tracing paper.
prompt_hi: Chintu ko sikhao ki tracing paper se kaise check karein ki design mein turn symmetry hai.
answer: Trace it, pin the tracing at the centre and turn it; if it matches before a full turn, it has turn symmetry; count the matches in one full turn

subject: maths
prompt_en: How many times does a square look the same in one full turn?
prompt_hi: Ek poore chakkar mein square kitni baar waisa hi dikhta hai?

subject: maths
prompt_en: On a dot grid, a dot is 2 dots to the left of the mirror line. Where does its mirror image go?
prompt_hi: Dot grid par ek bindu mirror line se 2 bindu baayein hai. Uski mirror image kahaan jaayegi?
answer: 2 dots to the right of the mirror line, in the same row

subject: maths
prompt_en: To make a kolam with quarter-turn symmetry, how many times must you repeat the motif around the centre?
prompt_hi: Quarter-turn symmetry wala kolam banane ke liye motif ko kendra ke chaaron taraf kitni baar dohraana hoga?
